why_head: Sellers pick the agent they already know.
why_lines: In real estate, sellers choose who they trust with their biggest asset.
The higher the price, the more they look at who you are and how you sell a home.
Short videos on you, your listings and the Downriver communities build that trust before the first meeting. Filmed once, they work on every listing.
org_1: Short videos on Grosse Ile and the Downriver communities you sell in
ads_1: Ads that reach buyers and sellers in those communities, cut from the same shoot
